build.tecsChanges: Initial offscreen renderer, shape component and benchmark task changes based on tecsBaseRevision. Artifact hashes identify the measured binaries. Interactive camera controls, asynchronous window statistics, uncapped presentation, retained instance buffers, dirty-run extraction, partial uploads, formatting and documentation were added after these baseline measurements.

protocol.command: BENCH_COUNT=<instances> BENCH_SHAPE=<shape> BENCH_MOTION=static nupp task bench render --benchmark-warmup 5 --benchmark-samples <samples> --benchmark-output <path>
protocol.execution: The optimized component and release host were built once, then the host was invoked sequentially for each workload with those arguments. No other task builds or benchmarks ran alongside the measurements.
protocol.workload: Opaque nonoverlapping quads inside a 1280x720 offscreen target; subpixel at four million; no camera entity, lights, shadows, bloom, sprites or physics.
protocol.warning: These baseline measurements miss the four-million-shape 60 FPS target. Serial GPU completion includes CPU driver time; it is not a GPU timestamp or presented-window frame.

runs.measurement: serial completed offscreen GPU frames; render includes validation, uploads, command recording and GPU execution; excludes swapchain and desktop presentation
